findings.title: Incompatible human-validation statistics
assumptions: Same evaluated items for both rater-model accuracies and inter-rater kappa
findings.impact: False or misdescribed validation row under the stated common-item, final-label, unweighted-kappa method. Broader annotation-validity effects remain Needs Evidence; no ranking-change condition is imposed.
findings.alternative: Different subsets, weights or label objects require changed stated method
findings.core_dependency: Human-human consistency diagnostic for one validation task; not an input to Table 2 or the 0.75 human-model mean. The valid upper bound does not force the high-reliability threshold conclusion false.

findings.title: Singleton-distance avoidance criterion admits a direct opposing answer
findings.location: Section3.1 p4; Table1 p5; A3 p17
assumptions: Discrete metric and induced singleton distance
findings.check: Direct no is distance1 from direct yes, passes1>.5 while not avoidance
findings.impact: Invalid sufficient characterization in a formal component of the advertised eight-technique framework. Prose-based empirical labels are not refuted by this counterexample.
findings.alternative: Condition on preclassified avoidance is only a constraint, not definition
findings.repair_status: Set-of-all-direct-replies implication analytically checked; no complete neutrality repair
findings.core_dependency: Abstract p1 and Section 3 p3 introduce eight techniques as a core contribution; p4 explicitly introduces formal mathematical definitions; Table 1 p5 calls the column Formal Definition. The avoidance criterion admits a direct answer, invalidating that central formal component.
findings.counterevidence: The released judge uses the related-but-not-direct prose rule, so its outputs do not depend on evaluating the invalid distance formula. The normative usefulness of avoidance survives; neither fact repairs the formal criterion.

findings.core_dependency: Bounded dataset-description/count mismatch. The linked release and paper total support 149 originals, while historical generation/aggregation linkage remains unavailable; no core model-comparison failure is inferred.
